# Andersen to Announce Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results


October 26, 2026 10:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_a14347d47a0b122a4a74dcf794b26af3/andersen/news/2026-10-26_Andersen_to_Announce_Third_Quarter_2026_Financial__265.pdf)


SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Andersen Group Inc. (NYSE: ANDG), a leading integrated professional services firm delivering tax, legal, valuation, global mobility and consulting services worldwide, will announce its financial results for the third quarter 2026 after the market closes on Thursday, November 12, 2026.


Andersen Chairman and CEO, Mark L. Vorsatz, and Andersen Chief Financial Officer, Neal Livingston, will host a conference call to discuss Andersen’s financial results on Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 5PM ET.


Participants can join the webcast at[https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=hogB1BOK](https://url.us.m.mimecastprotect.com/s/2Tt3C2k904h13Ygls1h3ws5xJAX?domain=event.choruscall.com) . The webcast replay link will be archived on Andersen’s Investor Relations website at investor.andersen.com within a few hours of the event and will remain on the website for six months.


**About Andersen Group Inc.**


Andersen Group Inc. is a leading integrated professional services firm delivering tax, legal, valuation, global mobility and consulting services worldwide. Andersen's differentiated approach to client service is rooted in core values that emphasize stewardship, transparency, and the seamless delivery of independent, high-quality service. Andersen's platform spans 180 countries through affiliates, member and collaborating firms operating from more than 1,000 locations, with over 3,000 partners and 50,000 professionals.
